title: Record the renewed assurance in vendors/github.json and refresh the GitHub vendor context
description: Run /refresh-vendor-ctx example-co for vendor github, or edit company-profile/example-co/vendors/github.json by hand in a reviewed commit with provenance workflow manual. Append a new assurance[] entry with type soc2-type2 (or the bridge-letter details in the scope text), issuer, periodStart, periodEnd, expiresAt (periodEnd + 12 months) and exceptionsCount from task 2. Leave the 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30 entry in place. Set lastAssessment.date to the task 2 review date. The refresh run then records the GV.SC.S4 observation for subject vendor github, so the finding's status can move through soc-ledger-keeper. Finish before the finding's slaDueAt, 2026-10-14T10:46:39Z.
acceptanceCriteria: company-profile/example-co/vendors/github.json has an assurance[] entry for GitHub Enterprise Cloud whose expiresAt is later than 2026-09-30 and whose periodStart is on or before 2025-10-01
company-profile/example-co/soc/main.jsonl has a new observation, collected after 2026-09-14T21:12:30Z, for control sebi-cscrf-2024:GV.SC.S4 with subject vendor github and result satisfied

verificationMethod.description: Run `node .claude/scripts/validate-data.mjs company-profile/example-co/vendors/github.json` (expect exit 0). Then read the latest ledger records for sebi-cscrf-2024:GV.SC.S4 and fnd_01M2FS4806WHXANC3Q9QXEAXGF. Expected: a satisfied observation for vendor github from the refresh-vendor-ctx run, and no new vendor-assurance-expiring flag for github-cloud. No probe-* workflow covers vendor assurance (the catalog probeWorkflows for both controls are refresh-vendor-ctx and refresh-soc), so a re-probe is not used.

rootCause.description: The vendor file holds only the provider's expiring report, so every assurance check against it will fail from 2026-10-01 until the renewed report is recorded.
